question: In Renal cell trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.
hidden_column: Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Control
pred_sql:
SELECT
  "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall",
  "Cancer type"
FROM clinical_trials
WHERE
  "Cancer type" = 'Renal cell';
